_note: The run report's test teams (tools/reports/run_report.gd, run_runner.gd --test-teams; docs/plans/tuning/test-teams.md and easy-start.md, ES-4). Each has a group (synergy: test-teams.md section 1's seventeen, phase 8 part 6's 8f-6; plan: easy-start.md section 5's plan teams, with the old three as the tank plan; bad: test-teams.md section 2's, stood in for by built heroes), fixed vows, and the items and relics its runs lean toward: for testing only, the shops and relic choices draw them `lean_weight` times as often (RunContent.test_lean) and the good bot tries them first. Bad teams have no build, so no lean.
